Keep original body proportions/camera/materials/equipment and coherent head/torso size across phases; conservative hidden-side detail only. Body/gear can articulate, not mirror.

All6 bodies same scale; don't solve leg poses by changing character or torso size. Fine armor opaque; alpha0 outside silhouette and between long connected gold spines. No floating rays, sparks, large bloom, backdrop, floor, shadow, fog, checkerboard, grid, labels or extra characters. Output game-ready high-detail native poses, not a poster. The actual visual result must show both near-leg-forward and FAR-leg-forward contacts and both opposite passing poses exactly as the provided motion guide.
